name: Duncan Hunter

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large multi-section industrial/commercial facility with two prominent white buildings and a few smaller buildings, including a residence|The majority of the property is made up rows of trees|A paved parking lot and road that encircles the buildings and farm|The site is bordered by trees and vegetation along parts of the perimeter, with open and undeveloped land visible in several areas|The facility includes roads providing access from multiple directions.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main buildings with several paved entry points into the property|Rows of trees extend across much of the property|Trees and landscaping are present along the edges, with additional structures visible toward the rear|The site is accessed via nearby roads.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the long rows of trees and support infrastructure|A smaller building and an area undeveloped land are visible|Trees line portions of this side of the property.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the continuation of the rows of trees and open areas.The two large white buildings are visible, along with  paved lane and some vegetation along the edges

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side elevation of smaller buildings and the  entirety of the tree farm|Trees and vegetation run along this side.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from multiple points around the perimeter via paved roads and parking areas. The large open layout with rows of trees and buildings provides access to and navigation around many areas. Mature trees along the perimeter may limit visibility from certain approaches. The site has multiple large structures and open areas that could support staging, though the rows of trees occupies a significant portion of the usable ground.
clarifications: Are any accesses gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the buildings? Are there multiple points of entry into the main buildings? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to specific areas of the site? What is the nature and use of the large white buildings on the property?
